correctness.rationale: The image/kernel criterion is independently derived from the averaging identity. The scalar-affine adjoint has eigenspaces line e+u and V with distinct eigenvalues 0 and 1 over every characteristic; an invariant complementary kernel must lie in V, hence is ideal. Each nonzero map is uniquely a linear projection on V plus a kernel vector. The Gaussian-binomial count, product formula, and dominated/tail asymptotic establish the full theorem. Independent exhaustive matrix enumeration checks q=2 dimensions 2-4, q=3 dimensions 2-3, and q=4 dimensions 2-3, including the endomorphism implication. These finite checks are not infinite proof.
